results.question: What is our total revenue?

cards.title: Total Revenue
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(net_amount_usd), 0) AS total_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: What was the gross revenue in 2023?

cards.title: 2023 Gross Revenue
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(f.gross_amount_usd)) AS gross_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines AS f JOIN core.dim_date AS d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE d.year = 2023

results.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?

cards.title: Orders in 2024
cards.sql: select count(distinct f.order_key) as order_count from core.fct_order_lines f inner join core.dim_date d on f.order_date = d.date_day where d.year = 2024

results.question: How many customers do we have?

cards.title: Registered Customers
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS registered_customers FROM core.dim_customer

cards.title: Buying Customers
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct customer_key) AS buying_customers FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: How many customers bought something in 2025?

cards.title: Buying Customers in 2025
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct f.customer_key) AS buying_customers FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE d.year = 2025

cards.title: Net Revenue in 2025
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE d.year = 2025

results.question: What is the average delivery time in days?

cards.title: Average Online Delivery Time (Days)
cards.sql: SELECT avg(delivery_days)::numeric(10,2) AS average_delivery_days FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE line_number = 0

results.question: How many orders took more than 7 days to deliver?

cards.title: Orders Taking > 7 Days
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct fct.order_key) AS long_delivery_orders FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fct INNER JOIN core.dim_store AS str ON fct.store_key = str.store_key WHERE str.sales_channel = 'Online' AND fct.line_number = 0 AND fct.delivery_days > 7

cards.title: Delivery Days Distribution
cards.sql: SELECT fct.delivery_days AS delivery_days, count(distinct fct.order_key) AS order_count FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fct INNER JOIN core.dim_store AS str ON fct.store_key = str.store_key WHERE str.sales_channel = 'Online' AND fct.line_number = 0 AND fct.delivery_days > 7 GROUP BY fct.delivery_days ORDER BY fct.delivery_days ASC

results.question: What is the net revenue of the online store compared to physical stores?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Sales Channel
cards.sql: SELECT t2.sales_channel AS sales_channel, round(sum(t1.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines AS t1 INNER JOIN core.dim_store AS t2 ON t1.store_key = t2.store_key GROUP BY t2.sales_channel ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

cards.title: Net Revenue Trend by Sales Channel
cards.sql: SELECT t3.year_month AS year_month, t2.sales_channel AS sales_channel, round(sum(t1.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines AS t1 INNER JOIN core.dim_store AS t2 ON t1.store_key = t2.store_key INNER JOIN core.dim_date AS t3 ON t1.order_date = t3.date_day GROUP BY t3.year_month_number, t3.year_month, t2.sales_channel ORDER BY t3.year_month_number

results.question: What is the net revenue from orders of customers paying in euros, expressed in euros?

cards.title: Net Revenue in Euros
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(net_amount_local), 0) as net_revenue_eur FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE currency_code = 'EUR'

cards.title: Net Revenue in Euros by Year
cards.sql: SELECT d.year as year, round(sum(f.net_amount_local), 0) as net_revenue_eur FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day WHERE f.currency_code = 'EUR' GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year

results.question: Which 3 product categories had the highest margin in 2025, and how much was it?

cards.title: Top 3 Categories by Margin (2025)
cards.sql: select p.category_name as category_name, round(sum(f.margin_amount_usd), 0) as margin_usd from core.fct_order_lines f join core.dim_product p on f.product_key = p.product_key join core.dim_date d on f.order_date = d.date_day where d.year = 2025 group by p.category_name order by margin_usd desc limit 3

results.question: What share of gross revenue do we give away in discounts?

cards.title: Discount Metrics Overview
cards.sql: SELECT sum(gross_amount_usd) AS gross_revenue_usd, sum(discount_amount_usd) AS discount_usd, sum(discount_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(gross_amount_usd), 0) AS discount_rate FROM core.fct_order_lines

cards.title: Discount Rate by Year
cards.sql: SELECT t.year AS year, sum(f.discount_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(f.gross_amount_usd), 0) AS discount_rate FROM core.fct_order_lines AS f INNER JOIN core.dim_date AS t ON f.order_date = t.date_day GROUP BY t.year ORDER BY t.year ASC

results.question: What is the margin rate of each product category?

cards.title: Margin Rate by Product Category
cards.sql: SELECT p.category_name AS category_name, round(sum(f.margin_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0), 4) AS margin_rate, round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd, round(sum(f.margin_amount_usd), 0) AS margin_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category_name ORDER BY margin_rate DESC

results.question: How many stores do we have?

cards.title: Total and Active Stores
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct store_code) as store_count, count(distinct store_code) filter (where status = 'Active') as active_store_count FROM core.dim_store

results.question: How many stores are open today?

cards.title: Active Stores
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct store_code) AS active_stores FROM core.dim_store WHERE status = 'Active'

results.question: How did net revenue develop year by year?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Year
cards.sql: SELECT d.year AS year, round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ASC

cards.title: Yearly Net Revenue Table
cards.sql: SELECT d.year AS year, round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd, count(distinct f.order_key) AS order_count FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ASC

results.question: What was the average order value in 2024?

cards.title: Average Order Value (2024)
cards.sql: select round(sum(f.net_amount_usd) / nullif(count(distinct f.order_key), 0), 2) as average_order_value_usd from core.fct_order_lines f join core.dim_date d on f.order_date = d.date_day where d.year = 2024

results.question: How much net revenue came from customers who were younger than 30 when they ordered?

cards.title: Net Revenue from Customers Under 30
cards.sql: SELECT sum(fct.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fct WHERE fct.customer_age < 30

cards.title: Net Revenue by Customer Age Group
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN fct.customer_age < 30 THEN 'Under 30' WHEN fct.customer_age BETWEEN 30 AND 49 THEN '30-49' ELSE '50+' END AS age_group, round(sum(fct.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fct GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

results.question: Customers from which country generated the most net revenue, and how much?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Country
cards.sql: SELECT c.country_name AS country, round(sum(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

results.question: How much net revenue was made on working days and how much on other days?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Day Type
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_working_day THEN 'Working Day' ELSE 'Non-Working Day' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount_usd), 0) AS net_revenue_usd FROM core.fct_order_lines f INNER JOIN core.dim_date d ON f.order_date = d.date_day GROUP BY d.is_working_day ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

results.question: Which 5 brands sold the most units?

cards.title: Top 5 Brands by Units Sold
cards.sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold FROM core.fct_order_lines f JOIN core.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
